g.text: Metamorph Sharia — market-entry platform: system architecture
Seven layers, top to bottom: sources → ingestion → platform core → storage and read contracts → AI layer → apps → users. Data flows down; questions flow up. Solid boxes are
built and live; dashed boxes are planned. As of 2026-10-28.
Today: one Docker Compose stack on a workstation (PostgreSQL,
object store, Airflow, MinerU, one image per connector). Later
on AWS: ECS tasks, Aurora Serverless v2, S3, EFS, Parameter
Store — deferred until every phase is built.
Access rules for every connector: it
names itself in its User-Agent, follows
only the links the pages show, and stops
at a refusal. No bot check is solved and
source, each run as a container
normalized documents · plain text with page markers · extraction record · PDF blobs
licensed_entity · series (frequencies, units, marks) · report (text + PDF blobs) · event (planned)
export a bundle → metamorph load and
when it is good, MinerU otherwise;
layout + OCR on a GPU, over HTTP — the
· Publish. Every rule lives in domain/
and application/, never in an adapter
checked in CI; private: only the web app
metamorph health: each load, and each
PostgreSQL 16 — one database, a schema per concern (★ = a read contract other teams build on)
the market system of record: entities, series, reports,
the market read contract: register, company, dataset,
pgvector: embeddings and full-text indexes, written
SeaweedFS locally, S3 on AWS: each PDF
as published, each extracted text, every
reads only the two read contracts; embeds; kept current
one chunk per provision_unit: citation, heading path,
one chunk per report_passage: report, issuer, pages,
one card per dataset and its series, for find_series
trigram matching on legal and other names
Retrieval MCP server — 7 deterministic tools: evidence, not answers; legal_force on every result; bounded and versioned
passages; hybrid search fused by RRF
outline, or a passage in context
the figures of these series over these
who is licensed, registered or gone,
plans, calls the tools and its own web search, weighs evidence by its legal_force, cites each ref, and writes the answer with an LLM
news, searched at question time — never stored
phase, each naming the refs, series or
companies it should find. A reranker is
kept only if it helps here
Tools read the retrieval indexes, and
the read contracts directly for whole
Next.js: review queue, document reader, text corrections, publish. Planned for
the market layer: the SEKI download note and a report reader
Market-entry platform app (planned): one research workspace over the customer journey, answers with cited evidence
The browser talks only to the Next.js
server; the curation API stays private.
review, correct, publish; drop SEKI and reports in by
